name: Bitwarden
author: Naitrate
description: Bitwarden vault status, PIN or master-password unlock, search, and copy actions in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Unlock with a PIN or master password, search logins, and copy usernames, passwords, or one-time codes.

schema.label: Clipboard clear delay (seconds)
schema.description: Clear a copied password or one-time code from the clipboard after this many seconds, if it has not been replaced.

schema.label: Hide email address
schema.description: Hide the account email from the bar tooltip and panel header, for screenshots and screen recordings.
